operating_income.source: AbbVie 10-K FY2025 consolidated statements of earnings, operating earnings (GAAP)

d_and_a.source: Depreciation (752/764/762) + amortization of intangibles (7,946/7,622/7,377) from 10-K cash flow statement via stock-analysis-on.net

capex.source: Purchases of PP&E, cash flow statement per stockanalysis.com (derived from 10-K)

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 grew 8.6%; growth from Skyrizi/Rinvoq offsetting Humira erosion, fading as the base grows. Not taken from company guidance.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 GAAP margin 24.6% was depressed by $6.5B contingent consideration FV change, $0.8B impairment; excluding those it is ~37%. 33% allows for amortization of $7.4B and ongoing IPR&D costs.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approximate AbbVie normalized/adjusted effective tax rate mid-teens; GAAP rate is distorted by non-deductible items.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 D&A 13.3% of revenue (8,139/61,160); slight decline as intangible amortization is flat against growing revenue.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 capex 2.0% of revenue (1,214/61,160), rising trend from 1.4% in FY2023.

wacc.source: Assumption: large-cap pharma, beta ~0.6-0.7, risk-free ~4.3%, ERP ~5% gives cost of equity ~7.5-8%; cost of debt ~5% pre-tax with heavy leverage; ~8% blended.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below long-run nominal GDP; allows for patent-cliff risk.

net_debt.source: At 31 Dec 2025: total LT debt and finance lease obligations 64,997 (10-K FY2025 debt note) + short-term borrowings 2,499 (Q2 2026 balance sheet Dec-25 column) − cash 5,229 − ST investments 28 (stockanalysis.com balance sheet). Finance leases are not separable, so slightly overstated.

diluted_shares.source: Weighted-average diluted shares FY2025, millions, AbbVie annual report/earnings release
